title: SAMPLE ONLY - Perp DEX market share check-in
thesis_summary: Our read: on-chain perp venues keep taking volume from centralised exchanges, but the share is concentrated in one venue and fee discounts drive part of the switch, so the lead is less durable than the headline share suggests.

title: SAMPLE ONLY - Stablecoin yield spreads
